regime.label: Short-gamma Protection — spot +18 rally above max pain, IV compressing, put OI accumulating
evidence: 1. Cumulative net dealer GEX is negative from 910 through 1070; gamma flip resolves at ~1080 — spot 1031 sits 49 pts below the flip, placing dealers squarely in short-gamma (trend-amplifying) territory.
2. PC OI ratio 1.22 and PC vol ratio 1.40 confirm put-heavy flow; session put OI surged +1,300 (4,875→6,175) vs call OI +544 (4,533→5,077) — new hedge demand layered above the rally.
3. IV ATM compressed 1.57 pp (17.35%→15.78%) on a +18-pt up session — vol sold into strength, not expanding into a fear-driven squeeze.
4. 91 DTE with no dominant near-money pin cluster: OI is still accumulating across the 1020–1080 range rather than consolidating for expiry-week pinning.

S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 futures rallied +18 pts to 1031.2, shifting the ATM 20 pts from 1010 to 1030 and vaulting spot 11 pts above the max-pain anchor at 1020. Total OI expanded +1,844 contracts; put OI dominated (+1,300) with the 1030-strike put adding 354 lots to 606 at 468 vol — the busiest single strike in the session, flagging fresh institutional hedges rather than short-covering. ATM IV fell 1.57 pp to 15.78% despite the rally, compressing the 1σ daily move estimate to 10.25 pts. Dealers remain short-gamma below the 1080 gamma flip; a sustained break of 1060 (771 call OI, 230 vol today — Vol2Vol confirmed live) would amplify toward that level.
what_changed: Spot: +18.0 pts (1013.3 → 1031.2); ATM shifted 20 pts from 1010 to 1030 — the largest move in the 2-session available history.
Max pain: drifted +10 pts (1010 → 1020), trailing spot by 11 pts — spot now above max pain.
IV ATM: compressed −1.57 pp (17.35% → 15.78%); 1030 put (252→606 OI, 468 vol) and 1030 call (376→440 OI, 248 vol) were the dominant flow strikes.
PC vol ratio: spiked to 1.40 from 0.57 — put flow decisively outpaced call flow even on a strong up day, consistent with Protection-zone hedge accumulation at elevated spot.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Only two sessions (Jun 27 and Jun 30) are available; the thesis is provisional and will sharpen as more history accumulates. The +18-pt rally paired with a −1.57 pp IV decline is a relief-rally signature — vol was sold, not bid. Max pain migrated +10 pts but trails spot by 11 pts, creating a gravitational pull back toward 1020 over the medium term if the rally fades. The 1030-strike put (252→606 OI, +354 in one session) has become the new primary put-burden node; any re-test of 1030 on volume activates fresh dealer delta-hedging at that level. Call OI has stacked at 1050–1080 (563/771/1110) across the two sessions, building a three-layer resistance corridor; notably, 1080 is both the global call wall and the gamma flip — a confirmed close above it shifts dealers from short to long gamma and changes move character. GEX sign has not flipped: spot has remained below 1080 and in short-gamma territory throughout, sustaining the trend-amplification bias on directional moves.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000/980 (downside insurance)
strategies.rationale: Protection zone with +2.75 pp put-rich skew and short-gamma below 1080: any pullback from 1031 through max pain (1020) and below the 1000 put support (401 OI) would be amplified by dealer delta-hedging; the debit spread captures that tail at defined, limited cost using the positively-skewed put side.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, approximately 5–6 pts (~1,000–1,200 baht/lot at 200 bt/pt). Max gain = 20 − debit if spot settles at or below 980 at expiry.
strategies.invalidation: Spot holds above 1020 max pain on a daily close and the 1030 ATM put cluster (606 OI) remains well-bid, negating the pullback thesis.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1060/1080 (short-gamma squeeze)
strategies.rationale: Spot sits 49 pts below the gamma flip (1080); a sustained break of the active 1060 call wall (771 OI, 230 vol — Vol2Vol live: volume confirmed, OI built, price approaching) forces dealers to buy delta into the move — short-gamma acceleration toward 1080; the debit spread caps risk while capturing the squeeze leg.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, approximately 7–8 pts (~1,400–1,600 baht/lot at 200 bt/pt). Max gain = 20 − debit if spot settles at or above 1080 at expiry.
strategies.invalidation: Spot fails to close above 1031 and reverses below 1020 (below max pain), negating the momentum/squeeze thesis.

S50U26.prediction: Bias is neutrally bullish near-term: the +18-pt session and IV compression suggest institutional positioning for higher prices, and the short-gamma environment below 1080 would amplify any continuation above 1060. However, the 11-pt gap between spot (1031) and max pain (1020) creates a gravitational mean-reversion pull; without follow-through volume, a drift toward 1020 is the path of least resistance. The thesis turns bearish on a daily close below 1020 with expanding put IV.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only — not trade advice. SET50 options are cash-settled against the SET50 index (not the futures), so the dealer-hedging mechanics that drive pinning in physically-settled single-stock options are structurally weaker here; max-pain levels should be treated as gravitational tendencies, not guaranteed targets. Short-vol defined-risk structures carry negative-skew payoff — frequent small gains, capped but real maximum loss; size small. Macro or news flow can override the option structure outright.
